name: Tic Tac Toe
author: Christopher Kleine
description: Classic tic-tac-toe on a 3x3 grid: take turns placing X and O and line up three in a row to win.

descriptions.en: Classic tic-tac-toe on a 3x3 grid: take turns placing X and O and line up three in a row to win.
descriptions.it: Il classico tris su una griglia 3x3: a turno si piazzano X e O, e chi mette tre simboli in fila vince.
